<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-Hant">
    <head>
        <meta charset="utf-8">
        <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
        <title>羅東座坐 Sit·Stay Brunch</title>
        <link rel="icon" href="data:image/jpeg;base64,">
        <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+TC:wght@400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
        <style>
            :root {
                --bg: #F4EDDC;
                --card: #FFFBF0;
                --ink: #2E2A25;
                --sub: #5E574B;
                --navy: #1F3A5F;
                --onnavy: #fff;
                --line: #CDBF9F;
                --acc: #B94A2E;
                --yolk: #E8B33C;
                --avo: #5F7F35;
                --onavo: #fff;
                --brown: #2C2622;
                --cream: #F4EDDC;
                --tag: #EADFC6;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);
                padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)
            }

            @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
                :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
                    --bg:#1B1D22;
                    --card: #25282F;
                    --ink: #EFEAE0;
                    --sub: #B8B1A3;
                    --navy: #6C93C9;
                    --onnavy: #10151D;
                    --line: #444852;
                    --acc: #EE9A7E;
                    --avo: #9DBB6B;
                    --onavo: #1B1D22;
                    --tag: #33363E;
                    color-scheme: dark
                }
            }

            :root[data-theme="dark"] {
                --bg: #1B1D22;
                --card: #25282F;
                --ink: #EFEAE0;
                --sub: #B8B1A3;
                --navy: #6C93C9;
                --onnavy: #10151D;
                --line: #444852;
                --acc: #EE9A7E;
                --avo: #9DBB6B;
                --onavo: #1B1D22;
                --tag: #33363E;
                color-scheme: dark
            }

            html {
                scroll-padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)
            }

            * {
                box-sizing: border-box
            }

            body {
                margin: 0;
                background: var(--bg);
                color: var(--ink);
                font-family: "Noto Sans TC","PingFang TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif;
                font-size: 16px;
                line-height: 1.75
            }

            .wrap {
                max-width: 560px;
                margin: 0 auto;
                padding: 16px 16px 40px
            }

            svg.i {
                width: 24px;
                height: 24px;
                flex: none;
                fill: none;
                stroke: currentColor;
                stroke-width: 2;
                stroke-linecap: round;
                stroke-linejoin: round
            }

            .hero {
                background: var(--brown);
                color: var(--cream);
                border-radius: 24px;
                text-align: center;
                padding: 22px 16px 20px
            }

            .logo {
                width: 96px;
                height: 96px;
                border-radius: 50%;
                object-fit: cover;
                display: block;
                margin: 0 auto 10px
            }

            .hero h1 {
                margin: 0;
                font-size: 28px;
                line-height: 1.3;
                letter-spacing: 4px
            }

            .hero .en {
                margin: 0 0 12px;
                letter-spacing: 3px;
                opacity: .85
            }

            .tape {
                display: inline-block;
                background: var(--yolk);
                color: #2E2A25;
                font-weight: 700;
                padding: 1px 14px;
                border-radius: 4px;
                transform: rotate(-1.5deg)
            }

            .hero .tape {
                font-size: 15px
            }

            nav {
                display: grid;
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
                gap: 12px;
                margin: 20px 0
            }

            nav button {
                min-height: 72px;
                border-radius: 18px;
                border: 2px solid var(--navy);
                background: var(--card);
                color: var(--navy);
                box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--navy);
                font: 700 17px/1.3 inherit;
                font-family: inherit;
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
                gap: 2px;
                cursor: pointer
            }

            nav button[aria-selected="true"] {
                background: var(--navy);
                color: var(--onnavy);
                transform: translateY(4px);
                box-shadow: none
            }

            section {
                display: none
            }

            section.on {
                display: block
            }

            .card {
                background: var(--card);
                border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
                border-radius: 18px;
                padding: 18px;
                margin-bottom: 16px
            }

            .card h2 {
                display: inline-block;
                font-size: 19px;
                margin: 0 0 12px;
                background: var(--yolk);
                color: #2E2A25;
                padding: 1px 14px;
                border-radius: 4px;
                transform: rotate(-1.2deg)
            }

            p {
                margin: 0 0 8px
            }

            .sub {
                color: var(--sub)
            }

            .row {
                display: flex;
                gap: 8px;
                align-items: baseline;
                padding: 7px 0
            }

            .dots {
                flex: 1;
                border-bottom: 2px dotted var(--line);
                min-width: 12px;
                transform: translateY(-4px)
            }

            .p {
                font-weight: 700;
                color: var(--acc);
                font-size: 17px;
                white-space: nowrap
            }

            .info .row {
                border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--line);
                justify-content: space-between
            }

            .info .row:last-child {
                border-bottom: 0
            }

            .t {
                display: inline-block;
                font-size: 12px;
                font-weight: 700;
                border-radius: 4px;
                padding: 0 6px;
                margin-left: 5px;
                line-height: 1.6;
                background: var(--navy);
                color: var(--onnavy);
                vertical-align: 2px
            }

            .t.h {
                background: var(--acc);
                color: #fff
            }

            .t.y {
                background: var(--yolk);
                color: #2E2A25
            }

            .t.g {
                background: var(--avo);
                color: var(--onavo)
            }

            .pills {
                display: flex;
                flex-wrap: wrap;
                gap: 8px;
                margin-top: 8px
            }

            .pills span {
                background: var(--tag);
                border-radius: 999px;
                padding: 2px 14px;
                font-size: 15px;
                font-weight: 500
            }

            .chips {
                display: flex;
                gap: 8px;
                flex-wrap: wrap;
                margin-bottom: 16px
            }

            .chips button {
                min-height: 44px;
                padding: 0 18px;
                border-radius: 999px;
                border: 1.5px solid var(--navy);
                background: transparent;
                color: var(--navy);
                font: 500 16px inherit;
                font-family: inherit;
                cursor: pointer
            }

            .chips button[aria-pressed="true"] {
                background: var(--navy);
                color: var(--onnavy)
            }

            .plate {
                padding: 12px 0;
                border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--line)
            }

            .plate:last-child {
                border-bottom: 0
            }

            .plate .hd {
                display: flex;
                gap: 8px;
                align-items: baseline;
                font-weight: 700
            }

            .num {
                display: inline-block;
                width: 28px;
                height: 28px;
                line-height: 24px;
                text-align: center;
                border-radius: 50%;
                border: 2px solid var(--acc);
                color: var(--acc);
                font-size: 14px;
                margin-right: 8px;
                transform: rotate(-8deg)
            }

            .plate small {
                display: block;
                color: var(--sub);
                font-size: 15px;
                line-height: 1.6;
                margin-top: 2px
            }

            .note {
                background: var(--tag);
                border-radius: 12px;
                padding: 10px 14px;
                font-size: 15px;
                margin: 10px 0 0
            }

            .rules {
                background: var(--brown);
                color: var(--cream);
                border-radius: 18px;
                padding: 16px 18px;
                margin-bottom: 16px
            }

            .rules h2 {
                display: inline-block;
                margin: 0 0 8px;
                font-size: 19px;
                background: var(--cream);
                color: var(--brown);
                padding: 1px 14px;
                border-radius: 4px;
                transform: rotate(-1.2deg)
            }

            .rules ul {
                margin: 0;
                padding-left: 20px
            }

            .btn {
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
                gap: 8px;
                min-height: 56px;
                border-radius: 16px;
                border: 2px solid var(--navy);
                background: var(--navy);
                color: var(--onnavy);
                font: 700 17px inherit;
                font-family: inherit;
                text-decoration: none;
                width: 100%;
                margin-bottom: 12px;
                cursor: pointer
            }

            .btn.alt {
                background: transparent;
                color: var(--navy)
            }

            .back {
                margin-top: 24px
            }

            .plateimg {
                display: block;
                width: 120px;
                height: 120px;
                margin: 0 auto 8px
            }

            label {
                display: block;
                font-weight: 500;
                margin: 12px 0 4px
            }

            input,select {
                width: 100%;
                min-height: 48px;
                border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
                border-radius: 12px;
                padding: 0 12px;
                font: 16px inherit;
                font-family: inherit;
                background: var(--bg);
                color: var(--ink)
            }

            #out {
                white-space: pre-line;
                background: var(--tag);
                border-radius: 12px;
                padding: 12px 14px;
                margin: 12px 0;
                display: none
            }

            footer {
                text-align: center;
                color: var(--sub);
                font-size: 14px;
                margin-top: 24px
            }

            footer a {
                color: var(--sub)
            }
        </style>
    </head>
    <body>
        <svg width="0" height="0" style="position:absolute" aria-hidden="true">
            <defs>
                <symbol id="i-home" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path d="M3 11l9-8 9 8M5 10v10h14V10"/>
                </symbol>
                <symbol id="i-pin" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path d="M12 21s7-6.2 7-11a7 7 0 10-14 0c0 4.8 7 11 7 11z"/>
                    <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="2.5"/>
                </symbol>
                <symbol id="i-fork" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path d="M7 3v8M4 3v5a3 3 0 006 0V3M7 11v10M17 21V3c-2.5 1.5-3 5-3 8h3"/>
                </symbol>
                <symbol id="i-cal" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="16" rx="3"/>
                    <path d="M3 10h18M8 3v4M16 3v4"/>
                </symbol>
                <symbol id="i-tel" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path d="M5 4h4l2 5-2.5 1.5a11 11 0 005 5L15 13l5 2v4a2 2 0 01-2 2A16 16 0 013 6a2 2 0 012-2z"/>
                </symbol>
                <symbol id="i-ig" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="5"/>
                    <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/>
                    <circle cx="17.5" cy="6.5" r=".6"/>
                </symbol>
                <symbol id="i-up" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path d="M12 19V5M6 11l6-6 6 6"/>
                </symbol>
            </defs>
        </svg>
        <div class="wrap">
            <header class="hero">
                <img class="logo" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="羅東座坐 Logo" width="96" height="96">
                <h1>羅東座坐</h1>
                <p class="en">SIT · STAY BRUNCH</p>
                <span class="tape">2026 版菜單</span>
            </header>
            <nav id="menu" role="tablist" aria-label="主選單">
                <button role="tab" data-t="overview" aria-selected="true">
                    <svg class="i">
                        <use href="#i-home"/>
                    </svg>
                    總覽
                </button>
                <button role="tab" data-t="info" aria-selected="false">
                    <svg class="i">
                        <use href="#i-pin"/>
                    </svg>
                    店家資訊
                </button>
                <button role="tab" data-t="menu" aria-selected="false">
                    <svg class="i">
                        <use href="#i-fork"/>
                    </svg>
                    菜單
                </button>
                <button role="tab" data-t="book" aria-selected="false">
                    <svg class="i">
                        <use href="#i-cal"/>
                    </svg>
                    立即訂位
                </button>
            </nav>
            <section id="overview" class="on">
                <div class="card">
                    <svg class="plateimg" viewBox="0 0 120 120" aria-hidden="true">
                        <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="55" fill="#EADFC6" stroke="#CDBF9F" stroke-width="2"/>
                        <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="42" fill="#FFFBF0"/>
                        <ellipse cx="45" cy="62" rx="16" ry="22" fill="#5F7F35"/>
                        <ellipse cx="45" cy="66" rx="10" ry="14" fill="#C8D98C"/>
                        <circle cx="45" cy="69" r="6" fill="#8A5A3B"/>
                        <circle cx="82" cy="50" r="16" fill="#fff" stroke="#E0D6BE" stroke-width="2"/>
                        <circle cx="82" cy="50" r="7" fill="#E8B33C"/>
                        <circle cx="78" cy="86" r="8" fill="#9DBB6B"/>
                    </svg>
                    <h2>歡迎來到座坐</h2>
                    <p>坐下來，慢慢吃一份早午餐。羅東座坐以澳式早午餐為主軸，搭配宜蘭鮮乳與蜂蜜飲品，也有與健身品牌合作的高蛋白餐盤。</p>
                    <div class="pills">
                        <span>澳式早午餐</span>
                        <span>宜蘭鮮乳</span>
                        <span>蜂蜜飲品</span>
                        <span>健身餐</span>
                    </div>
                    <p class="sub" style="margin-top:12px">老闆是宜蘭旅遊達人，提供免費旅遊諮詢。</p>
                </div>
                <div class="card">
                    <h2>店內人氣</h2>
                    <div class="row">
                        <span>
                            澳式酪梨盤<span class="t y">人氣</span>
                        </span>
                        <i class="dots"></i>
                        <span class="p">$370</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="row">
                        <span>
                            超營養拌飯<span class="t y">人氣</span>
                        </span>
                        <i class="dots"></i>
                        <span class="p">$320</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="row">
                        <span>
                            蜂蜜柚子茶<span class="t g">新品</span>
                        </span>
                        <i class="dots"></i>
                        <span class="p">$120</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="card">
                    <h2>營業時間</h2>
                    <p>
                        週一至週五 09:00～16:00<br>
                        <span class="sub">週三公休</span>
                    </p>
                </div>
                <div id="rules2"></div>
                <button class="btn" data-go="menu">
                    <svg class="i">
                        <use href="#i-fork"/>
                    </svg>
                    直接看菜單
                </button>
            </section>
            <section id="info">
                <div class="card info">
                    <h2>店家資訊</h2>
                    <div class="row">
                        <span class="sub">店名</span>
                        <span>羅東座坐 Sit·Stay Brunch</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="row">
                        <span class="sub">地址</span>
                        <span>265 宜蘭縣羅東鎮大新里公正路 34 號 1 樓</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="row">
                        <span class="sub">電話</span>
                        <a href="tel:039559229" style="color:var(--navy);font-weight:700">03-955-9229</a>
                    </div>
                    <div class="row">
                        <span class="sub">營業時間</span>
                        <span>週一～週五 09:00～16:00（週三公休）</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="row">
                        <span class="sub">Wi-Fi</span>
                        <span>Sitrest　密碼 039559229</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="row">
                        <span class="sub">Instagram</span>
                        <a href="https://www.instagram.com/sit.stay_brunch/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color:var(--navy);font-weight:700">@sit.stay_brunch</a>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <a class="btn" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=%E5%AE%9C%E8%98%AD%E7%B8%A3%E7%BE%85%E6%9D%B1%E9%8E%AE%E5%A4%A7%E6%96%B0%E9%87%8C%E5%85%AC%E6%AD%A3%E8%B7%AF34%E8%99%9F">
                    <svg class="i">
                        <use href="#i-pin"/>
                    </svg>
                    開啟地圖導航
                </a>
                <a class="btn alt" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://www.instagram.com/sit.stay_brunch/">
                    <svg class="i">
                        <use href="#i-ig"/>
                    </svg>
                    追蹤 Instagram
                </a>
                <div class="rules" id="rules">
                    <h2>入店規定</h2>
                    <ul>
                        <li>低消每人座坐餐盤一份或飲品一杯</li>
                        <li>外食勿入內食用</li>
                        <li>寵物需置放於籠內</li>
                        <li>用餐時間 90 分鐘</li>
                        <li>請降低音量</li>
                    </ul>
                </div>
            </section>
            <section id="menu-sec">
                <div class="chips" id="chips"></div>
                <div id="list"></div>
                <p class="sub" style="font-size:15px">
                    I＝冰飲　H＝熱飲<br>本店飲品採用鮮乳坊鮮乳。
                </p>
            </section>
            <section id="book">
                <div class="card">
                    <h2>立即訂位</h2>
                    <p class="sub">填寫資料後產生訂位內容，再撥打電話或複製給店家確認。</p>
                    <label for="n">姓名</label>
                    <input id="n" autocomplete="name">
                    <label for="d">日期</label>
                    <input id="d" type="date">
                    <label for="tm">時間</label>
                    <select id="tm">
                        <option>09:00</option>
                        <option>10:00</option>
                        <option>11:00</option>
                        <option selected>12:00</option>
                        <option>13:00</option>
                        <option>14:00</option>
                    </select>
                    <label for="c">人數</label>
                    <select id="c"></select>
                    <div id="out"></div>
                    <button class="btn" id="gen" style="margin-top:16px">
                        <svg class="i">
                            <use href="#i-cal"/>
                        </svg>
                        產生訂位內容
                    </button>
                    <a class="btn alt" href="tel:039559229">
                        <svg class="i">
                            <use href="#i-tel"/>
                        </svg>
                        撥打電話 03-955-9229
                    </a>
                    <p class="sub" style="font-size:15px">週三公休，用餐時間 90 分鐘。</p>
                </div>
            </section>
            <div id="backbox"></div>
            <footer>
                <a href="https://www.instagram.com/sit.stay_brunch/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Instagram @sit.stay_brunch</a>
                <br>© 2026 羅東座坐 Sit·Stay Brunch
            </footer>
        </div>
        <script>
            var drinks = [["咖啡", [["Espresso", 100, "H"], ["黑美式", 100, "IH"], ["拿鐵", 140, "IH"], ["蜂蜜拿鐵", 150, "IH"], ["冰釀咖啡", 150, "I", 1], ["西西里冰咖啡", 180, "I", 1], ["手沖咖啡", 180, "IH"]]], ["軟性飲品", [["蜂蜜柚子茶", 120, "IH", 1], ["鮮蜂蜜檸檬", 110, "I"], ["蜂蜜牛奶泡泡", 120, "I"], ["冬瓜檸檬", 100, "I"], ["純檸檬汁（無糖）", 100, "IH"], ["微氣泡水", 100, "I"], ["鮮乳坊鮮奶", 100, "IH"]]], ["宜蘭茶", [["好笑茶（台茶 12 號）", 100, "IH", 1], ["蜜香紅茶", 100, "H"], ["蜂蜜柚子紅茶", 140, "IH"], ["蜂蜜奶茶", 140, "H"]]]];
            var sweets = [["紅豆奶酪", 80], ["手工餅乾", 60]];
            var plates = [["澳式酪梨盤", 370, "酪梨片、芝麻酸種麵包、炒菇、烤時蔬、厚培根、歐姆蛋、生菜", 2], ["酪雞生菜盤", 320, "酪梨蛋片、舒肥雞胸、太陽蛋、巴薩米克油醋醬、生菜"], ["哈里薩酸種", 290, "酪梨片、芝麻酸種麵包、太陽蛋、哈里薩醬、生菜", 1, "哈里薩醬：紅甜椒與中東香料調和的醬料，香氣濃郁、帶點柔和辣感。"], ["520 單人套餐", 520, "豬里肌、太陽蛋、貝果、烤時蔬、炒菇、湯、點心、飲品、生菜"], ["炒飯餐盤", 260, "炒飯、豬里肌、太陽蛋"], ["超營養拌飯", 320, "藜麥飯、毛豆、炒菇、炒蛋、豬里肌、金柑醬", 2], ["訓練ㄟ氣力", 380, "燕麥優格杯、太陽蛋、雞腿排、炒菇、生菜"]];
            var singles = [["厚培根", 100], ["舒肥雞胸", 110, 1], ["豬里肌", 120], ["雞腿排", 140], ["鮭魚菲力", 180], ["炒飯", 100], ["太陽蛋", 60], ["歐姆蛋", 70, 1], ["酪梨花", 100], ["狡猾薯餅", 80, 1], ["燕麥優格杯", 120], ["主廚濃湯", 120], ["生菜沙拉", 120], ["芝麻酸種麵包", 80], ["花生醬貝果", 80], ["草莓醬貝果", 80]];

            function tg(k) {
                return k == 1 ? '<span class="t g">新品</span>' : k == 2 ? '<span class="t y">人氣</span>' : ''
            }
            function row(n, p, ih, k) {
                return '<div class="row"><span>' + n + tg(k) + (ih ? (ih.indexOf("I") > -1 ? '<span class="t">I</span>' : '') + (ih.indexOf("H") > -1 ? '<span class="t h">H</span>' : '') : '') + '</span><i class="dots"></i><span class="p">$' + p + '</span></div>'
            }
            var views = {
                "飲品": function() {
                    return drinks.map(function(g) {
                        return '<div class="card"><h2>' + g[0] + '</h2>' + g[1].map(function(i) {
                            return row(i[0], i[1], i[2], i[3])
                        }).join('') + '</div>'
                    }).join('')
                },
                "餐盤": function() {
                    return '<div class="card"><h2>座坐餐盤</h2><p class="sub">點餐盤加購飲品折 $50</p>' + plates.map(function(p, i) {
                        return '<div class="plate"><div class="hd"><span><span class="num">' + (i + 1) + '</span>' + p[0] + tg(p[3]) + '</span><i class="dots"></i><span class="p">$' + p[1] + '</span></div><small>' + p[2] + '</small>' + (p[4] ? '<div class="note">' + p[4] + '</div>' : '') + '</div>'
                    }).join('') + '<div class="note">6、7 號為「鋭突破 × 座坐」健身餐。</div></div>'
                },
                "單點": function() {
                    return '<div class="card"><h2>單點</h2>' + singles.map(function(i) {
                        return row(i[0], i[1], '', i[2])
                    }).join('') + '</div>'
                },
                "點心": function() {
                    return '<div class="card"><h2>點心</h2>' + sweets.map(function(i) {
                        return row(i[0], i[1])
                    }).join('') + '</div>'
                }
            };
            var chips = document.getElementById('chips')
              , list = document.getElementById('list');
            function show(k) {
                list.innerHTML = views[k]();
                [].forEach.call(chips.children, function(b) {
                    b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', b.textContent === k)
                })
            }
            Object.keys(views).forEach(function(k) {
                var b = document.createElement('button');
                b.textContent = k;
                b.onclick = function() {
                    show(k)
                }
                ;
                chips.appendChild(b)
            });
            show("餐盤");
            document.getElementById('rules2').innerHTML = document.getElementById('rules').outerHTML.replace(' id="rules"', '');

            var tabs = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('#menu button'));
            function go(t) {
                document.querySelectorAll('section').forEach(function(s) {
                    s.classList.toggle('on', s.id === (t === 'menu' ? 'menu-sec' : t))
                });
                tabs.forEach(function(b) {
                    b.setAttribute('aria-selected', b.dataset.t === t)
                });
                var bb = document.getElementById('backbox');
                bb.innerHTML = t === 'overview' ? '' : '<button class="btn alt back" id="bk"><svg class="i"><use href="#i-up"/></svg>返回主選單</button>';
                if (t !== 'overview')
                    document.getElementById('bk').onclick = function() {
                        document.getElementById('menu').scrollIntoView({
                            behavior: 'smooth',
                            block: 'center'
                        })
                    }
                    ;
                window.scrollTo({
                    top: 0,
                    behavior: 'smooth'
                });
            }
            tabs.forEach(function(b) {
                b.onclick = function() {
                    go(b.dataset.t)
                }
            });
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-go]').forEach(function(b) {
                b.onclick = function() {
                    go(b.dataset.go)
                }
            });

            var c = document.getElementById('c');
            for (var i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
                c.add(new Option(i + ' 位',i))
            }
            c.value = 2;
            var d = document.getElementById('d');
            d.min = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
            d.value = d.min;
            document.getElementById('gen').onclick = function() {
                var n = document.getElementById('n').value.trim() || '（未填）';
                if (!d.value) {
                    alert('請選擇日期');
                    return
                }
                if (new Date(d.value + 'T00:00:00').getDay() === 3) {
                    alert('週三公休，請改選其他日期');
                    return
                }
                var txt = '【羅東座坐訂位】\n姓名：' + n + '\n日期：' + d.value + '\n時間：' + document.getElementById('tm').value + '\n人數：' + c.value + ' 位';
                var o = document.getElementById('out');
                o.textContent = txt;
                o.style.display = 'block';
                try {
                    navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(function() {
                        o.textContent = txt + '\n\n已複製，請撥電話與店家確認。'
                    })
                } catch (e) {}
            }
            ;
        </script>
    </body>
</html>
